name: Retell AI
h1: Retell AI ARR: $60M, Up 650% Year over Year.
intro: Retell AI sells the infrastructure layer for voice agents — a conversation API with turn-taking, interruption handling and telephony that developers use to build AI phone products. Sacra estimates its run rate at $60M, growing 650% year over year, about twenty-seven months after launch per Leonis Capital. The sourced numbers are below.

The conversation API launches; developer teams building AI phone products adopt it instead of stitching speech-to-text, LLM and telephony stacks together.

modelTitle: Metered Minutes: The AWS Pattern for Phone Agents.
modelParagraphs: Retell's insight is that voice AI products don't fail on the model's ability to speak — they fail on conversation mechanics: when to talk, how to handle interruption, how to stay natural across latency. Retell productized those mechanics into a conversation API with telephony attached, so a developer team can ship an AI phone line without assembling a speech stack.

Pricing is usage-based per minute, which makes revenue compound with every product built on top: each customer's success raises their spend automatically. That's the infrastructure pattern — metered consumption, no enterprise sales cycle — and it's why the 650% growth figure is structurally plausible rather than promotional.

faqs.q: What Is Retell AI's ARR in 2026?
faqs.a: Around $60 million per Sacra, growing about 650% year over year. Retell has not disclosed exact revenue; treat the figure as a research estimate. Leonis Capital independently charts roughly twenty-seven months from launch to $50M.

A conversation API for building voice agents: turn-taking, interruption handling and natural pacing, plus telephony. Developers use it to ship AI phone products without assembling their own speech-to-text, LLM and calling stack.

faqs.q: Why Is It Growing 650% a Year?
faqs.a: Usage-based pricing on an infrastructure layer: every voice-agent product built on Retell meters minutes, and successful customers raise spend automatically as their call volume grows — no new sales motion required.
Shangding Gu, a Stanford PhD, founded the company in 2023. The founding focus was conversation mechanics — the listening side of voice AI — rather than model quality.

faqs.q: How Is Retell Different from ElevenLabs?
faqs.a: ElevenLabs leads with voice synthesis — making speech sound human. Retell leads with conversation orchestration — deciding when and how the agent talks within a live phone call. Developers often use both layers in the same product.
